hin_Deva_to_en.in: धान की फसल में कितना यूरिया डालना चाहिए?
hin_Deva_to_en.out: How much urea should be added to the paddy crop?

hin_Deva_to_en.in: गेहूं की सिंचाई कब करनी चाहिए?

kan_Knda_to_en.out: How much urea should be applied to the rice crop?
How much seed is required for the millet crop?

en_to_hin_Deva_roundtrip.in: Apply 10 kg N/ha (22 kg urea) at the time of first puddling.
en_to_hin_Deva_roundtrip.translated: पहले गड्ढे के समय 10 कि. ग्रा. एन./हेक्टेयर (22 कि. ग्रा. युरिया) लगाएं।
en_to_hin_Deva_roundtrip.back: Apply 10 kg एन./हेक्टेयर (22 kg urea) at the time of first pit.

en_to_hin_Deva_roundtrip.in: Apply NPK @ 100 : 50 : 50 kg / ha as a basal dose.
en_to_hin_Deva_roundtrip.translated: एन. पी. के. @100:50:50 किग्रा/हेक्टेयर को मूल खुराक के रूप में लागू करें।
en_to_hin_Deva_roundtrip.back: Apply NPK @ 100:50:50 kg / ha as the original dose.

en_to_hin_Deva_roundtrip.in: Maintain 2.5 cm depth of water after transplanting.
en_to_hin_Deva_roundtrip.translated: प्रत्यारोपण के बाद पानी की 2.5 सेमी गहराई बनाए रखें।
en_to_hin_Deva_roundtrip.back: Maintain a depth of 2. 5 cm of water after transplantation.

en_to_hin_Deva_roundtrip.in: Use a seed rate of 60 kg for short duration varieties and 20 kg for hybrids.
en_to_hin_Deva_roundtrip.translated: अल्पकालिक किस्मों के लिए 60 कि. ग्रा. और संकर के लिए 20 कि. ग्रा. के बीज दर का उपयोग करें।
en_to_hin_Deva_roundtrip.back: Use a seed rate of 60 kg for short-lived varieties and 20 kg for hybrids.

en_to_kan_Knda_roundtrip.in: Apply 10 kg N/ha (22 kg urea) at the time of first puddling.
en_to_kan_Knda_roundtrip.translated: ಮೊದಲ ಪುಡ್ಡಿಂಗ್ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ 10 ಕೆ. ಜಿ. ಎನ್/ಹೆಕ್ಟೇರ್ (22 ಕೆ. ಜಿ. ಯುರಿಯಾ) ಅನ್ನು ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಿ.
en_to_kan_Knda_roundtrip.back: Apply 10 kgn / ha (22 kg urea) during the first pudding.

en_to_kan_Knda_roundtrip.in: Apply NPK @ 100 : 50 : 50 kg / ha as a basal dose.
en_to_kan_Knda_roundtrip.translated: ಎನ್. ಪಿ. ಕೆ. @<ಐ. ಡಿ. 1> ಕೆ. ಜಿ/ಹೆಕ್ಟೇರ್ ಅನ್ನು ಬೇಸಲ್ ಡೋಸು ಆಗಿ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಿ.
en_to_kan_Knda_roundtrip.back: Apply NPK @ < ID1 > kg / ha as a basal dose.

en_to_kan_Knda_roundtrip.in: Maintain 2.5 cm depth of water after transplanting.
en_to_kan_Knda_roundtrip.translated: ನಾಟಿ ಮಾಡಿದ ನಂತರ 2.5 ಸೆಂಟಿಮೀಟರ್ ಆಳದ ನೀರನ್ನು ಕಾಪಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.
en_to_kan_Knda_roundtrip.back: After planting, maintain a depth of 2.5 cm.

en_to_kan_Knda_roundtrip.in: Use a seed rate of 60 kg for short duration varieties and 20 kg for hybrids.
en_to_kan_Knda_roundtrip.translated: ಅಲ್ಪಾವಧಿಯ ತಳಿಗಳಿಗೆ 60 ಕೆ. ಜಿ. ಮತ್ತು ಮಿಶ್ರತಳಿಗಳಿಗೆ 20 ಕೆ. ಜಿ. ಬೀಜದ ದರವನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ.
en_to_kan_Knda_roundtrip.back: Use a seed rate of 60 kg for short-lived varieties and 20 kg for hybrids.
